sketches.mechanism: Object finalization can resurrect an object: during __del__, storing self somewhere reachable prevents the deletion from being final.
sketches.resonance: The last gesture of a disappearing thing can be to make itself remain.
sketches.draft:
saved = None
class Ghost:
    def __del__(self):
        global saved
        saved = self
g = Ghost()
del g

sketches.mechanism: fork() duplicates the running process, and both parent and child continue from the same next instruction with different return values.
sketches.resonance: One moment becomes two lives without either moving backward.

sketches.mechanism: Variables are single-assignment pattern matches; attempting to bind an already-bound variable to a different value raises a badmatch.
sketches.resonance: What has truly been named cannot quietly become something else.
